rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: Release dated February 7, 2002: 'A Royal Decree was issued today announcing the appointment of Dr. Saleh bin Abdullah bin Humaid as Chairman of the Consultative Council (Majlis Al-Shura) with the rank of Minister.'
